messages:
maria: Quick sync — proposing a phased rollout for request/response telemetry redaction + sampling. Draft below, want feedback on retention windows, heuristics, and console UX. TL;DR: default 1% full payload sampling, 10% metadata-only, redact PII with hybrid regex+ML, opt-in for dev teams. RFC: https://go/r/redact-rollout

kevin: How does 1% impact debuggability for high-error routes? worried about edge cases where sampled records miss root cause.

maria: plan is route-aware sampling: error routes bump to 5-10% for 24h after incident, and we keep bounded artifact retention. Raw payload retention default 7d, metadata 90d. Aggregates stored longer.

sasha: Route-aware is good. On detection: regex for SSN/ccn/email vs ML for names/addresses — what's our threshold? ML costs CPU and latency.

maria: hybrid approach: regex first-pass (high precision), then optional ML fuzzy for opt-in routes. We'll also preserve a hash for redacted tokens so teams can correlate without storing raw PII. Example config:

```json
{
  "version": "1",
  "default_sampling_pct": "1",
  "metadata_sampling_pct": "10",
  "route_overrides": {"auth.login": "10", "api.v1/generate": "2"},
  "redaction": {"strategy": "hybrid", "preserve_hash": true, "hash_salt_id": "rotating-salt-v1"},
  "retention_days": {"raw_payload": "7", "metadata": "90", "aggregates": "365"}
}
```

ellie: UX ask — teams need a simple canary slider and an explicit "enable ML detection" toggle per route. Also show estimated cost delta in the console when they change sampling or ML.

kevin: Agreed. Also add a safety 'panic-mode' where we temporarily ramp metadata-only sampling to 100% for an hour for incident triage.

sasha: Note on keys: hash salt rotation must be KMS-backed and audited. If salt rotates, we lose prior correlation — need a migration/alias plan.

maria: Good call. We'll design salt aliases + rollover and document how to request re-correlations (time-limited).

deploy-bot: rollout-plan created: redact-rollout-v1 (canary: eng-staging) :rocket:

maria: I'll update the RFC with these pieces (salt rotation, canary slider mockups, cost estimates). Please add comments on the doc by EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:
